title: Kompressa Prime
extract:
Kompressa Prime is the Primed counterpart of the  Kompressa bubblegun, sporting increased Critical Chance, Status Chance, explosion damage, and explosion radius. Kompressa Prime was released alongside  Yareli Prime and  Daikyu Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals  Viral damage.
Bubbles explode in a 2.8 meter radius after 0.6 - 0.8 seconds on impacting a surface or enemy.
Explosion delay reduces likelihood of inflicting  self-stagger, but may allow enemies to move out of the explosion range if not directly hit by the bubble.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Can benefit from  Fulmination ( Primed).

Acquisition

Notes

When wielded by  Yareli ( Prime),  Kompressa ( Prime) gains +30% Projectile Speed.
Although Kompressa's bubble projectiles are extremely inaccurate at long ranges, the resulting delayed AoE explosions can still deal good damage. Equipping  Fulmination ( Primed) can help compensate for the inaccuracy at such ranges by expanding the AoE range.
Has a hidden synergy with  Surging Blades, allowing the blades to be captured by bubbles when blades are thrown into bubble clusters allowing them to grow in size and shred enemies who get near them.
Due to a bug versus a significant number of large enemies, (such as the Profit-Taker Orb and H-09 Efervon Tank) the bubbles from the Kompressa will deal the initial damage on impact, but not attach an exploding bubble. This leads to a massive decrease in damage, effectively making the weapon useless against these enemies.

Tips

Kompressa's delayed burst damage can prove advantageous against crowds of enemies that are protected by a Nullifier Crewman or, in Arbitrations, Arbitration Shield Drones, as the initial shot impact can destroy these protective barriers while the resulting exploding blobs can proceed to clear out the once protected enemies.
The Kompressa is functionally silent despite having an "Alarming" noise level; the bubbles and explosions can be fired near enemies without alerting them. However, they will still break  Ivara's  Prowl unless the  Suppress mod is equipped.
 Cascadia Empowered is a viable enhancement for Kompressa, due to its capacity for landing a lot of status effects on enemies.
 Secondary Encumber is a great option for priming.
